text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan claims a brilliant victory in 
the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Basking in the packed crowd's affectionate 
chants of "Cute Curren Chan!", she flashed 
a truly fulfilled smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That day, Curren Chan's followers 
skyrocketed. She trended #1 worldwide and 
garnered an unimaginable number of 
"Uma-likes."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Curren Chan truly became the most 
beloved Umamusume in the entire world, 
both in name and in deed. But who was the 
one who loved her the deepest of all—?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"You know that already, riiight?" ...she 
teased, acting adorably affectionate.
